ads.headline: Lift Everyday Stains.
ads.signType: a huge roadside BILLBOARD beside a busy city highway, shot from the road with traffic below and sky behind
ads.brief: Bright daylight, realistic highway with cars, the billboard dominant and crystal sharp. Small LACALUT White & Repair tube in the billboard bottom corner.
ads.label: WHITE & REPAIR SIGN S1

ads.headline: WARNING: Coffee Stains Add Up.
ads.signType: a weathered yellow-and-black INDUSTRIAL WARNING / caution metal sign, distressed with rust and scratches, bolted to a wall
ads.brief: The word WARNING huge across the top in heavy black caps on yellow, the rest of the message below in bold black. Gritty realistic metal. Small LACALUT White & Repair tube at the bottom of the sign.
ads.label: WHITE & REPAIR SIGN S2

ads.headline: Brighter Teeth, The Gentle Way.
ads.signType: a bright yellow POST-IT NOTE stuck on a bathroom mirror, handwritten in marker
ads.brief: Real bathroom mirror with soft reflection, morning light, the post-it in sharp focus with bold handwritten marker text. LACALUT White & Repair tube sitting small on the vanity.
ads.label: WHITE & REPAIR SIGN S3

ads.headline: German Whitening That's Enamel-Kind.
ads.signType: a push NOTIFICATION banner popping up at the top of a phone lock screen, bold notification title text
ads.brief: Realistic phone lock screen held in hand, time and battery at top, the LACALUT notification banner bold and legible. A small LACALUT White & Repair tube on a surface behind the phone.
ads.label: WHITE & REPAIR SIGN S4

ads.headline: Whiter, The German Way.
ads.signType: bold lettering TATTOOED across the upper BACK of a person photographed from behind in a natural candid setting
ads.brief: Candid real photo from behind, natural skin and lighting, the tattoo text large, crisp and easy to read. LACALUT White & Repair tube resting small on a bench in the background.
ads.label: WHITE & REPAIR SIGN S5

ads.headline: Brighter Smile.
ads.signType: a few words written across the FOREHEAD of a person, candid close-up portrait in a real everyday setting
ads.brief: Candid close-up of a believable everyday Australian, slight smile, the forehead text bold and clearly legible. Hold the message very short so it fits large across the forehead.
ads.label: WHITE & REPAIR SIGN S6
